Hi Ethan / Claire,

Great talking earlier — as promised I’m attaching a starter Mutual Action Playbook (MAP) and a short evaluation agenda you can adapt. The goal is to get a lightweight 4–6 week pilot plan we can run with your team that proves latency, cost, and integration points.

What’s in this packet:
- BrightTap_MAP_Template_v1.gslides — high-level MAP deck (stakeholders, milestones, success criteria)
- BrightTap_Eval_Agenda_v1.docx — 6-week evaluation timeline and recommended checkpoints
- BrightTap_MVPAcceptanceChecklist.pdf — simple QA/acceptance for the pilot

Suggested next steps:
1) Confirm stakeholders (business + engineering) and a technical POC (name + email).
2) Pick a kickoff window (30–45 minute working session) next week to co-edit the MAP slides.
3) Marissa will own the success metrics section; Priyom will handle what security artifacts you need for procurement.

I put a first draft in this Google Doc for collaborative edits: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aXz-BrightTap-MAP-draft (view/comment) and the slides here: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1bYz-BrightTap-MAP-slides

If it helps, I can run a 30-minute workshop during the kickoff to align stakeholders on the 6-week plan. Proposed times: Tue 3/9 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 3/10 14:00–14:30 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this going.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
